senses.en: to lower someone in rank, dignity, or respect

ex.en: He refused to abase himself by begging for his old job back.
ex.zh: 他不願意低聲下氣地求回原本的工作。

senses.en: a building where monks or nuns live and worship

ex.en: Tourists crowded into the ancient abbey to admire its stained glass.
ex.zh: 遊客擠進古老的修道院欣賞彩繪玻璃。

root.note: 院長管理的地方 → 修道院

senses.en: the man who is head of a monastery

ex.en: The abbot rang the bell to call the monks to prayer.
ex.zh: 修道院院長敲鐘召集修士們禱告。

root.note: 修士們的「父親」→ 院長

senses.en: to give up a throne or high office
to fail to carry out a duty or responsibility

ex.en: Parents cannot simply abdicate responsibility for their children's education.
ex.zh: 父母不能就這樣放棄教育孩子的責任。

root.note: 宣告離開（王位）→ 退位

senses.en: the part of the body containing the stomach and intestines; the belly

ex.en: The patient complained of a sharp pain in his abdomen.
ex.zh: 病人抱怨腹部劇烈疼痛。

senses.en: relating to the abdomen

ex.en: Sit-ups strengthen the abdominal muscles.
ex.zh: 仰臥起坐可以鍛鍊腹部肌肉。

senses.en: the act of taking someone away illegally by force

ex.en: Police are investigating the abduction of a local businessman.
ex.zh: 警方正在調查一名當地商人遭綁架的案件。

senses.en: in bed

ex.en: The old man lay abed until noon on cold winter days.
ex.zh: 寒冷的冬日，那位老人總是在床上躺到中午。

senses.en: to encourage or help someone do something wrong

ex.en: The driver was charged with helping to abet the robbery.
ex.zh: 那名司機被控協助搶劫。

mn: 常見片語 aid and abet（協助犯罪）。

senses.en: a state of temporary disuse or suspension

ex.en: The building project is in abeyance until funding is found.
ex.zh: 在找到資金之前，建案暫時擱置。

parts.m: gape 張口等待（古法文 baer）

root.note: 張著嘴等待 → 懸而未決

mn: 常用片語 in abeyance（擱置中）。

senses.en: a feeling of intense hatred or disgust

ex.en: She expressed her abhorrence of violence in any form.
ex.zh: 她表示痛恨任何形式的暴力。

root.note: 嚇得發抖而退開 → 憎惡

senses.en: causing hatred or disgust; morally unacceptable

ex.en: Most people find cruelty to animals abhorrent.
ex.zh: 大多數人都覺得虐待動物令人憎惡。

root.note: 讓人嚇得發抖退開的 → 可憎的（horror 同源）

senses.en: the act of obeying or following a rule; also, staying

ex.en: Strict abidance by the rules is expected of every member.
ex.zh: 每位成員都必須嚴格遵守規則。

senses.en: (of a bad situation) extremely severe or hopeless
without pride or dignity

ex.en: Many families in the region live in abject poverty.
ex.zh: 這個地區有許多家庭生活極度貧困。

root.note: 被丟到一旁的 → 悲慘的、卑賤的

senses.en: to formally reject or give up a belief or claim
senses.zh: 公開放棄（信仰、主張）；發誓斷絕

ex.en: The prisoner was forced to abjure his political beliefs.
ex.zh: 那名囚犯被迫公開放棄自己的政治信念。

root.note: 發誓遠離 → 公開放棄

senses.en: physically strong and healthy

ex.en: Every able-bodied villager helped rebuild the bridge after the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水過後，每個身強體壯的村民都幫忙重建橋梁。

senses.en: the act of washing oneself, often as a religious ritual

ex.en: The pilgrims performed a ritual ablution before entering the temple.
ex.zh: 朝聖者進入神廟前先進行淨身儀式。

root.note: 把髒東西洗掉 → 淨身

senses.en: to give up or deny oneself something

ex.en: Monks abnegate worldly pleasures to focus on spiritual life.
ex.zh: 修士捨棄世俗享樂，專注於靈性生活。

senses.en: different from what is usual or expected, often in a worrying way

ex.en: The scan showed an abnormal growth in her lung.
ex.zh: 掃描顯示她的肺部有異常的腫塊。

root.note: 偏離標準的 → 異常的

senses.en: causing disgust or hatred; very bad

ex.en: The prisoners were kept in abominable conditions.
ex.zh: 囚犯被關在惡劣至極的環境裡。

root.note: 被視為凶兆而避開的 → 可憎的

mn: 雪怪的英文就是 the Abominable Snowman（可怕的雪人）。

senses.en: to detest or hate intensely

ex.en: I abominate hypocrisy.
ex.zh: 我痛恨虛偽。

ex.en: She has always abominated cruelty, especially toward children.
ex.zh: 她一向痛恨殘忍的行為，尤其是對孩子的殘忍。

root.note: 視為凶兆而躲開 → 痛恨

senses.en: something that causes disgust or hatred

ex.en: The critic called the new glass tower an abomination.
ex.zh: 那位評論家說這座新的玻璃大樓簡直是醜陋的怪物。

senses.en: existing in a land from the earliest times; native

ex.en: The museum displays aboriginal art from across the continent.
ex.zh: 博物館展出來自整片大陸的原住民藝術。

root.note: 從一開始就在的 → 原住民的

senses.en: the earliest known inhabitants of a region

ex.en: The aborigines of the island had lived there for thousands of years.
ex.zh: 這座島的原住民已在那裡生活了數千年。

root.note: 從最初就居住在此的人

senses.en: honest and open; without secrecy

ex.en: The whole deal was completely aboveboard, with every document made public.
ex.zh: 整筆交易完全光明正大，每份文件都有公開。

root.note: 手放在桌面上（打牌不作弊）→ 光明正大

senses.en: to scrape or wear away by rubbing

ex.en: Years of wind and sand had begun to abrade the stone statue.
ex.zh: 多年的風沙已開始磨損那座石像。

senses.en: a scraped area of skin; the process of wearing away by rubbing

ex.en: She fell off her bike and got a painful abrasion on her knee.
ex.zh: 她從腳踏車上摔下來，膝蓋擦傷了，很痛。

senses.en: to shorten a book or text without losing its meaning
to limit or reduce a right

ex.en: The publisher decided to abridge the novel for younger readers.
ex.zh: 出版社決定為年輕讀者出版這本小說的刪節版。

root.note: 使變短 → 刪節（brief 同源）

senses.en: a shortened version of a book or text

ex.en: I read an abridgment of the novel because the original is over a thousand pages.
ex.zh: 我讀的是那本小說的刪節版，因為原著超過一千頁。

senses.en: to formally cancel or repeal a law or agreement

ex.en: The new government moved quickly to abrogate the unpopular treaty.
ex.zh: 新政府迅速廢除了那項不受歡迎的條約。

root.note: 把提過的法案拿掉 → 廢除

senses.en: sudden and unexpected
brief to the point of rudeness

ex.en: The meeting came to an abrupt end when the fire alarm went off.
ex.zh: 火災警報一響，會議就突然結束了。

senses.en: a swollen area in body tissue containing pus

ex.en: The dentist drained the abscess under his tooth.
ex.zh: 牙醫把他牙齒下方的膿腫引流出來。

root.note: （體液）離開正常位置聚集 → 膿腫

senses.en: the natural shedding of leaves or fruit from a plant; the act of cutting off

ex.en: Shorter days trigger leaf abscission in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天白晝變短會引發葉子脫落。

root.note: 切離 → 脫落（scissors 剪刀同源）

senses.en: to leave secretly, often to avoid arrest or with stolen money

ex.en: The treasurer tried to abscond with the club's funds.
ex.zh: 財務長企圖捲走社團的經費潛逃。

root.note: 偷偷藏起來離開 → 潛逃

senses.en: the state of being away; the lack of something

ex.en: In the absence of evidence, the judge dismissed the case.
ex.zh: 由於缺乏證據，法官駁回了這個案子。

senses.en: forgetful or not paying attention

ex.en: The absent-minded professor left his umbrella on the bus again.
ex.zh: 那位心不在焉的教授又把雨傘忘在公車上了。

senses.en: formal release from guilt, blame, or punishment

ex.en: He confessed his mistake and asked for absolution.
ex.zh: 他承認錯誤並請求原諒。

senses.en: to declare someone free from guilt, blame, or responsibility

ex.en: The report did not absolve the company of responsibility for the spill.
ex.zh: 報告並沒有免除公司對漏油事件的責任。

root.note: 鬆開罪責 → 赦免（solve、dissolve 同源）

senses.en: to take in liquid, energy, or information
to hold someone's full attention

ex.en: Plants absorb water through their roots.
ex.zh: 植物透過根部吸收水分。

senses.en: the process of taking something in; complete attention

ex.en: Vitamin D helps the body's absorption of calcium.
ex.zh: 維生素 D 有助於身體吸收鈣質。

senses.en: to choose not to do something, especially something enjoyable
to choose not to vote

ex.en: Athletes must abstain from alcohol during training season.
ex.zh: 運動員在訓練期間必須戒酒。

root.note: 把自己抓住、遠離 → 戒除

senses.en: the practice of not doing or having something, especially alcohol

ex.en: After years of heavy drinking, he chose total abstinence.
ex.zh: 酗酒多年後，他選擇完全戒酒。

senses.en: difficult to understand; obscure

ex.en: The lecture on quantum theory was too abstruse for most of the audience.
ex.zh: 那場量子理論講座對大多數聽眾來說太深奧了。

root.note: 被推到遠處藏起來 → 深奧難懂

senses.en: wildly unreasonable or ridiculous

ex.en: It is absurd to expect students to read five novels in one week.
ex.zh: 期待學生一週讀完五本小說實在很荒謬。

senses.en: existing in large quantities; more than enough

ex.en: Fish are abundant in the cold waters off the coast.
ex.zh: 沿岸的冷水海域魚類豐富。

root.note: 像波浪一樣滿溢出來 → 豐富的

senses.en: extremely offensive and insulting; involving cruelty

ex.en: The fan was removed from the stadium for shouting abusive language.
ex.zh: 那名球迷因為大聲辱罵而被請出球場。

root.note: 不當使用 → 濫用、虐待的

senses.en: (of land or a building) to be next to or touch

ex.en: Their backyard gardens abut each other, separated only by a low fence.
ex.zh: 兩家的後院緊鄰，中間只隔著一道矮籬笆。

root.note: 盡頭碰在一起 → 毗鄰

senses.en: a very deep hole; a disastrous situation

ex.en: The country was on the edge of an economic abyss.
ex.zh: 那個國家正處於經濟崩潰的邊緣。

senses.en: relating to education and scholarship
not of practical relevance; theoretical
senses.zh: 純理論的；無實際意義的

ex.en: Her academic performance improved after she joined the study group.
ex.zh: 她加入讀書會後，學業表現進步了。

parts.m: Akademia 柏拉圖講學的園林

root.note: 源自柏拉圖的學院 → 學術的

senses.en: a member of an academy, especially one for arts or sciences

ex.en: She was elected an academician for her research in physics.
ex.zh: 她因物理學研究而獲選為院士。

senses.en: a school for special training; a society of scholars or artists

ex.en: He trained at a military academy before joining the army.
ex.zh: 他從軍前在軍事學院受訓。

parts.m: Akademia 柏拉圖講學的園林

root.note: 柏拉圖講學之處 → 學院

senses.en: to agree to a request or demand
to take up an office or position, such as a throne

ex.en: The principal refused to accede to the students' demands.
ex.zh: 校長拒絕答應學生的要求。

root.note: 走向（對方的立場）→ 同意

mn: 別和 exceed（超過）搞混：accede 是「同意」。

senses.en: to increase speed; to make something happen sooner

ex.en: New technology will accelerate the pace of change.
ex.zh: 新科技將加速改變的步調。

senses.en: to agree to take something offered; to believe or come to terms with

ex.en: She was thrilled to accept the scholarship offer.
ex.zh: 她很高興地接受了獎學金。

mn: 別和 except（除了…之外）搞混。

senses.en: the means or right to enter or use something
to reach or obtain, especially data

ex.en: Every student has access to the library's online database.
ex.zh: 每個學生都能使用圖書館的線上資料庫。

senses.en: able to be reached, entered, or used
easy to understand

ex.en: The author writes about science in a style that is accessible to everyone.
ex.zh: 這位作者用人人都讀得懂的方式寫科學。

root.note: 可以走進去的 → 可進入、易懂的

senses.en: the act of reaching a position of power, such as a throne
a new item added to a collection

ex.en: The queen's accession to the throne was celebrated across the country.
ex.zh: 女王登基受到全國慶祝。

senses.en: an extra item that adds to something; a fashion item
a person who helps someone commit a crime

ex.en: A scarf can be a stylish accessory in winter.
ex.zh: 圍巾在冬天可以是很有型的配件。

root.note: 跟著走的東西 → 附屬品、從犯

senses.en: enthusiastic public praise
to praise enthusiastically and publicly

ex.en: Her first novel won wide acclaim from critics.
ex.zh: 她的第一本小說廣受評論家讚揚。

root.note: 對著人大喊（喝采）→ 讚揚

senses.en: to provide lodging or space for
to adapt to or fit in with someone's needs

ex.en: The hotel can accommodate up to three hundred guests.
ex.zh: 這家飯店最多可以容納三百位客人。

root.note: 使尺寸剛好合適 → 容納、配合

mn: 拼字注意：兩個 c、兩個 m。

senses.en: music played to support a singer or instrument
something that goes along with something else

ex.en: She sang with a simple piano accompaniment.
ex.zh: 她在簡單的鋼琴伴奏下演唱。

senses.en: a person who plays music to support a singer or soloist

ex.en: The choir's accompanist has played the piano for them for twenty years.
ex.zh: 合唱團的伴奏者已經為他們彈了二十年的鋼琴。

senses.en: to go somewhere with someone
to happen or exist together with

ex.en: A parent must accompany each child on the field trip.
ex.zh: 校外教學時，每個孩子都要有一位家長陪同。

ex.en: Children under twelve must be accompanied by an adult.
ex.zh: 十二歲以下的兒童必須由大人陪同。

senses.en: a person who helps another commit a crime

ex.en: The thief's accomplice waited in the getaway car.
ex.zh: 小偷的共犯在逃跑用的車裡等著。

root.note: 被摺在一起、牽連在內的人 → 共犯

senses.en: to succeed in doing or completing something

ex.en: We can accomplish a lot more if we work together.
ex.zh: 如果我們合作，能完成的事會多很多。

root.note: 填滿 → 完成（complete 同源）

senses.en: a musical instrument with bellows and keys, played by squeezing

ex.en: An old man played the accordion on the street corner.
ex.zh: 一位老人在街角拉手風琴。

senses.en: to approach and speak to someone boldly or aggressively

ex.en: Reporters rushed to accost the senator as he left the building.
ex.zh: 參議員一走出大樓，記者就衝上前攔住他。

root.note: 走到身旁 → 上前搭話

senses.en: a report or description of an event
an arrangement to keep money with a bank
to give an explanation (account for)

ex.en: Her account of the accident differed from the driver's.
ex.zh: 她對事故的描述跟司機的說法不同。

root.note: 計算清楚 → 帳目、交代

senses.en: to dress or equip, especially for military service

ex.en: The knights would accouter themselves in armor before the tournament.
ex.zh: 騎士們在比武大會前會穿上盔甲。

parts.m: sew, dress 縫製、穿著（古法文）

senses.en: to officially recognize as meeting a standard
to give credit to someone for something

ex.en: An independent board will accredit the new medical school.
ex.zh: 將由一個獨立委員會認證這所新醫學院。

senses.en: to gather or increase gradually over time

ex.en: Dust will accumulate quickly if you don't clean the shelves.
ex.zh: 如果不清理架子，灰塵很快就會堆積。

senses.en: the quality of being correct and precise

ex.en: Please check the accuracy of your calculations.
ex.zh: 請檢查你計算的準確度。

senses.en: correct in all details; exact

ex.en: The witness gave an accurate description of the suspect.
ex.zh: 目擊者準確地描述了嫌犯的樣貌。

root.note: 小心做成的 → 準確的

senses.en: under a curse; hateful or very annoying

ex.en: The sailors believed the ship was accursed after so many storms.
ex.zh: 遇上那麼多暴風雨後，水手們相信這艘船被詛咒了。

senses.en: a claim that someone has done something wrong

ex.en: He strongly denied the accusation of cheating.
ex.zh: 他強烈否認作弊的指控。

root.note: 對人提起訴訟 → 指控

senses.en: suggesting that someone has done something wrong

ex.en: She gave him an accusatory look when the vase was found broken.
ex.zh: 發現花瓶破了的時候，她用責怪的眼神看著他。

senses.en: to say that someone has done something wrong or illegal

ex.en: It is unfair to accuse someone without any proof.
ex.zh: 沒有任何證據就指控別人是不公平的。

root.note: 對人提出訴訟 → 指控

senses.en: to make someone used to something

ex.en: It took weeks to accustom ourselves to the cold climate.
ex.zh: 我們花了好幾週才習慣寒冷的氣候。

senses.en: sharpness or bitterness of taste or manner

ex.en: The critic was known for the acerbity of his reviews.
ex.zh: 那位評論家以尖刻的評論聞名。

senses.en: a salt or ester of acetic acid; a type of plastic film

ex.en: The teacher wrote notes on a sheet of clear acetate for the projector.
ex.zh: 老師在透明投影片上寫筆記給投影機使用。

senses.en: relating to vinegar or acetic acid

ex.en: Vinegar gets its sour taste from acetic acid.
ex.zh: 醋的酸味來自醋酸。

senses.en: a continuous dull pain
to suffer continuous dull pain; to long for

ex.en: After the long hike, I had an ache in my knees.
ex.zh: 長途健行後，我的膝蓋隱隱作痛。

senses.en: like Achilles; invulnerable or heroic, yet with one weak spot
senses.zh: 像阿基里斯般的；英勇無敵的

ex.en: The general showed Achillean courage in battle.
ex.zh: 將軍在戰場上展現阿基里斯般的勇氣。

root.note: 希臘神話英雄，全身刀槍不入，唯獨腳跟是弱點（Achilles' heel）

senses.en: without color; (of a lens) not splitting light into colors

ex.en: The artist painted the room in achromatic shades of black, white, and gray.
ex.zh: 這位藝術家把房間漆成黑、白、灰等無彩色的色調。

senses.en: a chemical substance with a sour taste that can burn or dissolve things
sour; (of remarks) sharp and hurtful

ex.en: Lemon juice contains citric acid.
ex.zh: 檸檬汁含有檸檬酸。

senses.en: to make or become acidic

ex.en: Rising carbon dioxide levels acidify the oceans.
ex.zh: 二氧化碳濃度上升使海洋酸化。

ex.en: Pollution can acidify lakes and kill the fish in them.
ex.zh: 污染會使湖泊酸化，讓湖裡的魚死亡。

senses.en: to admit that something is true
to show that you have noticed or received something

ex.en: The company refused to acknowledge any wrongdoing.
ex.zh: 公司拒絕承認有任何不當行為。

senses.en: acceptance of the truth of something; an expression of thanks

ex.en: The author listed her teachers in the acknowledgment at the front of the book.
ex.zh: 作者在書前的致謝辭裡列出了她的老師們。

senses.en: the highest point of achievement or excellence

ex.en: Winning the gold medal was the acme of her career.
ex.zh: 贏得金牌是她職業生涯的巔峰。

parts.m: point, peak 尖端（希臘文 akmē）

senses.en: relating to sound or hearing
(of an instrument) not electrically amplified

ex.en: He played an acoustic guitar at the small café.
ex.zh: 他在那間小咖啡館彈木吉他。

senses.en: to make someone aware of or familiar with something

ex.en: New employees need time to acquaint themselves with the software.
ex.zh: 新進員工需要時間熟悉這套軟體。

senses.en: reluctant acceptance without protest

ex.en: His silence was taken as acquiescence to the plan.
ex.zh: 他的沉默被視為默許這個計畫。

senses.en: to get or obtain something, often through effort

ex.en: It takes years to acquire fluency in a foreign language.
ex.zh: 要花好幾年才能流利地說一種外語。

root.note: 尋求而得到 → 獲得（inquire、require 同源）

senses.en: something obtained; the act of obtaining

ex.en: The museum's latest acquisition is a rare Chinese scroll.
ex.zh: 博物館最新的收藏是一幅罕見的中國卷軸。

senses.en: to declare someone not guilty of a crime
to behave or perform in a certain way (acquit oneself)

ex.en: The jury voted to acquit the defendant of all charges.
ex.zh: 陪審團投票宣判被告所有罪名均不成立。

root.note: 使（罪名）免除 → 宣告無罪

senses.en: a judgment that a person is not guilty

ex.en: The acquittal surprised everyone who had followed the trial.
ex.zh: 無罪判決讓所有關注這場審判的人都很驚訝。

senses.en: release from a debt; a written receipt for payment

ex.en: The merchant gave him a signed acquittance once the debt was paid.
ex.zh: 債務還清後，商人給了他一張簽名的收據。

senses.en: an area of land measured in acres

ex.en: The farm's total acreage has doubled in ten years.
ex.zh: 這座農場的總面積十年來增加了一倍。

senses.en: having a bitter, unpleasantly sharp smell or taste
angry and bitter

ex.en: Acrid smoke from the burning tires filled the air.
ex.zh: 燃燒輪胎冒出的刺鼻濃煙瀰漫空中。

root.note: 尖銳刺激的 → 刺鼻的（acrimony 同源）

senses.en: angry and bitter (of speech or a discussion)

ex.en: The two candidates held an acrimonious debate on television.
ex.zh: 兩位候選人在電視上進行了一場火藥味十足的辯論。
